==Biography==
===2015 Season===
Sin "'''Nuclear'''" Jeong-hyeon played for [[Quvic E-Sports]] during the [[Champions Spring 2015/Qualifiers|Champions Spring 2015 Qualifiers]] but they lost 2-1 to [[Xenics]] in the group stage. The team disbanded on February 14, 2015. He joined [[Prime Clan]] in March 2015 as their ad carry. They qualified for [[SBENU Champions Summer 2015]] after going 1-1 in their group against [[Samsung Galaxy]] and Xenics during [[Champions Summer 2015/Promotion|Champions Summer 2015 Promotion]]. Afterwards, Prime was sponsored by SBENU and renamed themselves to [[SBENU Sonicboom]]. Nuclear shares the starting ad carry position with [[Dan (Kim Seung-hoo)|Dan]]. SBENU placed last in Champions Summer and were forced to play in the [[LCK/2016 Season/Spring Promotion|LCK 2016 Season Spring Promotion]]. SBENU played [[ESC Ever|Ever]] and managed to win 3-1 to requalify for the LCK.

===2016 Preseason===
SBENU played in the [[2015 LoL KeSPA Cup]] where they lost 2-1 in the quarterfinals to [[SK Telecom T1]].

===2016 Season===
During the [[LCK/2016 Season/Spring Season|2016 LCK Spring Season]], SBENU Sonicboom went 2-16 in sets, finishing in ninth place, forcing them to play relegations matches for their spot in the summer split. SBENU chose [[ESC Ever]] as their relegations opponent, but were defeated 3-0, relegating them to [[Challengers Korea/2016 Season/Summer Season|Challengers Korea 2016 Summer]].
